messages:
Sanjay: Quick sync — attaching the company goals slate for FY27 Q2. Need alignment on which of these 5 bets become top-level company OKRs and which live at area level. TL;DR: prioritizing Dedicated + Private rollout, cost optimization, and reliability. Please react with :thumbsup: to confirm or :eyes: for questions.

Erin: reading now. can we flag the "Dedicated capacity optimization" item as conditional on infra capacity? Mike, what's realistic runway for the batching/kv-cache work?

Mike: FYI infra capacity is tight. We can do a focused batching sprint (2 engineers) to shave p50 by ~10-15% in 6 weeks. Full KV cache overhaul is a Q3 project unless we deprioritize some smaller bets.

Laura: from product-design POV, launch criteria need explicit acceptance: UX for private deploy dashboard, onboarding flow, and one security audit signoff. Otherwise rollout will be messy.

Priya: sales input — we have 2 late-stage pilots (FinRegCo, HealthKit) asking for Private deployment in-app by end of quarter. They're sensitive to SSO and audit logs. If we can't commit to Private GA, we should set expectations now.

Taylor: decision needed: do we make Private deployment a company OKR or a Dedicated/Enterprise area OKR? Big customer impact but heavy cross-team work.

Erin: proposal — make "Private GA" an area-level OKR owned by Eng-Platform + Sales, but make "Improve unit economics by 20%" a company OKR. That buys us a cross-cutting metric while letting Private be delivered by a smaller team with exec oversight.

Sanjay: pros/cons? Concern: if Private isn't a company OKR, exec attention might wane and pilots could slip. But company OKR must be measurable and impact many teams.

Mike: measurable engineering metric suggestion: reduce per-token infra cost by 20% via batching, quantization guidance, and LRU cache. We can break this into 3 milestones.

Laura: add user-facing acceptance tests: onboarding < 15 minutes, default policy for keys, and audit log export. If these aren't in the rollout criteria, Sales will push back.

Priya: agreed. also need a comms plan for pilot customers. I'll draft emails and a "what to expect" one-pager.

Taylor: my leaning — company OKR = "Improve serving economics by 20% (tokens/unit cost)"; area OKR = "Private GA for regulated pilots". Exec will sponsor Private but not make it the top-level metric.

Erin: I'll update the draft and ship a new slate by EOD. action items:
- Erin: update OKR draft + owner assignments
- Mike: provide capacity estimates and milestone breakdown by Tue
- Laura: define UX acceptance criteria doc
- Priya: pilot comms + list of required security deliverables

Sanjay: thanks. if no objections by EOD I'll mark this as agreed and start signoff process. :white_check_mark:

DeployBot: Poll created — "Agree to proposed OKR split?" Options: Yes / Needs exec escalation / Need more info. Vote ends in 24h.

Taylor: :thumbsup: 

Mike: +1

Priya: +1

Laura: +1
